Artistic swimming, formerly synchronized swimming, combines dance, gymnastics and swimming in spectacular choreographies under water. The athletes perform acrobatic moves and synchronized figures to music - with full body control, breathing technique and power. The teams from Australia, Spain, Canada, France, the USA, the Republic of Korea, Austria, Ukraine, New Zealand, Great Britain, Italy and Mexico give us a some insights into the hard training they put in to win a medal at the Olympic Games.
